title: b7z9.37.1.2(c-ii): runtime test for root-sig DIO option (needs DIO-option emission seam)
description: Coverage follow-up from b7z9.37.1.2(c) (worker-6): the receiver wiring for OPT_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE (0x17) landed in receive.rs (decode via DecodedRootSig, verify structural+signature against the link-authenticated sender pubkey, RootSeqCache consumption post-verification, fail-closed RplRejected on any failure, absent-option = normal L679 processing). The runtime test could not land: root.send_dio() builds the DIO from router state (no option-injection seam), and the plaintext Stack::send_ipv6_uncompressed_to path bypasses the DIO admission gate entirely. Needed: an emission seam for authenticated DIOs carrying arbitrary options (e.g. build_authenticated_dio accepting extra options, or a raw-frame injection helper like the C routing_dispatch tests use), then port the tampered-option test from the abandoned worker-6 draft (vector oracle COSE bytes with one flipped byte, assert non-delivery).
